Almost 15 years in SEO, optimising for position 1...

And now it's all about to change. For better? or worse? I guess we'll know soon enough.

We’ve just published our latest deep dive into how AI is changing search, and the numbers speak for themselves:

➡️ AI Overviews now appear in 33% of all searches
➡️ 57% of B2B Tech-related queries now feature AI summaries (that’s a 32% increase in a year)
➡️ When AI Overviews show up, organic CTR can drop up to 54.6% (Everyone is feeling the CTR erosion)

But!

⚡Brands featured within those AI Overviews are seeing their CTR jump from 0.74% to 1.02%.

I always thought of SEO as a game. A game where you know half the rules and the other half changes every 2 weeks. 

In this case, the game has become a lot harder...
